title: A Woman Rode a Bicycle 183 Miles an Hour

scenes.text: A woman rode a bicycle 183 miles an hour.
Denise Mueller-Korenek is towed behind a dragster.
The dragster blocks the wind, then she lets go and keeps pedaling.
Her top speed: 183.9 miles an hour.
Her own reaction: we weren't supposed to go more than 175.

description:
A woman rode a bicycle 183 miles an hour.
In September 2018 Denise Mueller-Korenek hit 183.931 mph at the Bonneville Salt Flats, riding in the slipstream of a dragster before pedaling alone.
How fast have you ever gone on a bike?
first_comment: Bonus: she said, we weren't supposed to go more than 175. Would you try it?
